sections.title: Delete Collections
sections.description: If enabled, deletes all collections created by previous runs that are no longer in the source.
toggles: When enabled: Only collections with the Kometa label (Managed) will be deleted.
When enabled: Only collections defined in the current config file will be eligible for deletion.
When enabled: Excludes empty smart collections from being affected by the less item count check. This allows retaining things like smart collections that show movies without subtitles or the like.
